extracted.intended_audience: authors submitting short/flash/short-fiction speculative stories to Strange Horizons
extracted.subtask_short: submitting speculative fiction to Strange Horizons
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for writers preparing and submitting speculative-fiction stories to the online magazine Strange Horizons, covering eligibility, length, formatting, rights, pay, and submission procedures. Targeted to prospective contributors of short stories and translations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: We want: Speculative fiction, broadly defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your story doesn't have a speculative element, or strong speculative-fiction sensibilities, it's probably not for us. We welcome all subgenres and forms of speculative fiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Word-length limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Up to 10,000 words (under 5000 preferred).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We prefer stories under 5,000 words, but consider up to 10,000; the longer the story, the less likely we are to be interested. The wordcount limit is not absolutely inflexible but we can't consider stories much over the limit, not even as serials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wordcount determination
rubrics_metrics.description: We determine story length by taking the word-processor wordcount and rounding up to the next highest 100 words.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format and file types
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send only RTF, DOC or DOCX files and try to stick to standard manuscript format as much as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include your name and contact information in the upper left; you may also add your pronouns (optional). Submissions must be uploaded via the Moksha submissions system—no email or postal submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission channel and scheduling
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitted through our Moksha submissions system—no email or postal submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Our usual schedule: we open to submissions between Monday 1600 UTC and Tuesday 1600 UTC, every week of the year except usually during December. Check the top of the page to see if we're open before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous and multiple submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: No simultaneous or multiple submissions; no re-submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please wait 7 days after receiving a rejection before you submit again. Submissions sent to us and another venue simultaneously will not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previously submitted to Strange Horizons
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories previously submitted to Strange Horizons, even if they have been revised, will not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partial or incomplete stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Partial or incomplete stories — Please don't send us part of a story and ask us to request the rest of it if we're interested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previously published in English / reprints
rubrics_metrics.description: Previously unpublished in English—we buy first English rights, including audio. Unsolicited reprints of works previously published in English will not be considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We buy first-printing world exclusive English-language rights (including audio rights) for six (6) months. After that period, you are free to republish the story elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translations policy and Samovar
rubrics_metrics.description: Special note on translations: our quarterly sister magazine Samovar specializes in translations and offers a better pay rate of 12¢/word USD split between author and translator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We encourage you to submit translations to Samovar directly. Translations submitted to either magazine will always be considered for both magazines: first for Samovar and second for Strange Horizons. If you're sending us a translation and don't want it forwarded to Samovar, please let us know in your cover letter and we will consider it only for Strange Horizons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment rates and terms
rubrics_metrics.description: We pay 10¢/word (USD), with a minimum payment of $60.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Payment is made within 60 days of contract; we pay by check or PayPal according to the author's preference. Strange Horizons is recognized by SFWA as a professional market.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rights, exclusivity and archives
rubrics_metrics.description: We buy first-printing world exclusive English-language rights (including audio rights) for six (6) months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After that period you are free to republish. We hope you'll allow us to leave the story in our archives indefinitely after it's rotated off the main table of contents, but you have the right to remove your story from the archives at any time after one (1) year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover letter content
rubrics_metrics.description: Your cover letter can be minimal: generally, these should be short and list just a few of your most recent or most relevant publications or workshops.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have life experience relevant to your story, mention it. Cover letters shouldn't include plot synopses or pitches. See sample cover letters page for examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response autoresponse and contact protocol
rubrics_metrics.description: We send an autoresponder message in response to every submission we receive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you haven't received an autoresponse within 24 hours after submitting, please query immediately (missing an autoresponse usually means we have an incorrect email address for you). If you have questions, write to fiction@strangehorizons.com with 'QUERY:' at the start of the subject line and a few words indicating the topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response times and patience
rubrics_metrics.description: We usually respond within a few weeks, but are currently running behind and response times are slower.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please query if you're concerned your submission has gone astray, but otherwise be patient while we catch up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal policy
rubrics_metrics.description: After you submit a story, we strongly prefer you don't withdraw it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you withdraw a story, we won't consider any version of that story in the future. However, if you do need to withdraw a story, please send an e-mail telling us that you need to withdraw, and let us know why.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content standards: profanity, sex, violence, gore
rubrics_metrics.description: Profanity is fine. Sex or violence in a story should be artistically justified; no excessive gore.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content preferences: diversity and representation
rubrics_metrics.description: We love fiction from or about diverse perspectives and traditionally under-represented groups, settings, and cultures, written from a non-exoticizing and well-researched position.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories should avoid exoticizing cultures or perspectives and should be informed and well-researched when representing under-represented groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stylistic openness and readability
rubrics_metrics.description: Unusual yet readable styles and inventive structures and narratives are welcome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We appreciate experimental approaches (including hypertext/interactive fiction), but readability remains important; if you have a nonstandard form, query editors to discuss submission procedure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political content
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories that address political issues in complex and nuanced ways, resisting oversimplification, are of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonfiction/Poetry exclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry or nonfiction; we're the wrong department for those.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit poetry and nonfiction to the appropriate Strange Horizons departments or other outlets; this guideline applies to the fiction submissions queue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple stories from same author
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple stories at once from the same author are not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: International submissions and spelling
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome submissions from anywhere in the world, and British spellings are fine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hypertext/interactive/nonstandard forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Hypertext fiction, interactive fiction, and other stories that explore and exploit the forms available to us are of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have such a work that you think might be a good fit for Strange Horizons, please query us to discuss how to submit it.
